osebe.opis_en: Founder of North Korea who started the Korean War by invading the South and built a totalitarian hereditary dictatorship with camps for political prisoners.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Kim Il Sung, 1950: z napadom na Južno Korejo sproži korejsko vojno
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Kim Il Sung, 1950: invades South Korea, starting the Korean War

osebe.opis_sl: Turško-mongolski osvajalec, ki je na pohodih od Indije do Anatolije pustošil mesta in množično pobijal prebivalstvo, npr. v Delhiju in Bagdadu.
osebe.opis_en: Turco-Mongol conqueror whose campaigns from India to Anatolia devastated cities and massacred populations, as in Delhi and Baghdad.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Timur, Delhi 1398: zavzame in opustoši mesto ter pobije velik del prebivalcev
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Timur, Delhi 1398: sacks the city and massacres much of its population

osebe.opis_sl: Prvi ruski car, ki je z opričnino uvedel teror nad plemstvom in prebivalstvom, vključno s pokolom v Novgorodu, in leta 1581 smrtno ranil lastnega sina.
osebe.opis_en: First Tsar of Russia, who used the oprichnina to impose terror on the nobility and population, including the massacre of Novgorod, and fatally wounded his own son in 1581.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Ivan Grozni, Novgorod 1570: opričniki pobijejo na tisoče prebivalcev mesta
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Ivan the Terrible, Novgorod 1570: the oprichniki massacre thousands of the city's inhabitants

osebe.opis_sl: Ustanovitelj fašizma, ki je kot vodja Italije (1922–1943) uvedel diktaturo, napadel Etiopijo in kot Hitlerjev zaveznik vodil Italijo v drugo svetovno vojno.
osebe.opis_en: Founder of fascism who, as Italy's leader (1922–1943), imposed a dictatorship, invaded Ethiopia and took Italy into the Second World War as Hitler's ally.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Mussolini, Rim 1922: po pohodu na Rim postane predsednik vlade
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Mussolini, Rome 1922: becomes prime minister after the March on Rome

osebe.opis_sl: Vladar Hunov, ki je s pohodi pustošil po Balkanu, Galiji in severni Italiji, leta 452 razdejal Oglej in izsiljeval davek od Vzhodnega rimskega cesarstva.
osebe.opis_en: King of the Huns whose campaigns ravaged the Balkans, Gaul and northern Italy, who sacked Aquileia in 452 and extorted tribute from the Eastern Roman Empire.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Atila, Katalaunska polja 451: rimsko-vizigotska vojska ustavi njegov vdor v Galijo
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Attila, Catalaunian Plains 451: Roman and Visigothic forces halt his invasion of Gaul

osebe.opis_sl: Vodja SS in nemške policije, ki je organiziral sistem koncentracijskih in uničevalnih taborišč ter bil eden glavnih izvajalcev holokavsta.
osebe.opis_en: Head of the SS and the German police who organised the system of concentration and extermination camps and was a chief architect of the Holocaust.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Himmler, Dachau 1933: kot šef münchenske policije odpre koncentracijsko taborišče Dachau
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Himmler, Dachau 1933: as Munich police chief opens the Dachau concentration camp

osebe.opis_sl: Srbski in jugoslovanski predsednik, čigar nacionalistična politika je prispevala k vojnam ob razpadu Jugoslavije; umrl je med sojenjem za vojne zločine v Haagu.
osebe.opis_en: Serbian and Yugoslav president whose nationalist policies fuelled the wars of Yugoslavia's breakup; he died during his war crimes trial in The Hague.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Milošević, Kosovo Polje 1987: nagovor kosovskim Srbom sproži njegov nacionalistični vzpon na oblast
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Milošević, Kosovo Polje 1987: his address to Kosovo Serbs launches his nationalist rise to power

osebe.opis_sl: Kot vodja vojaške hunte Derg je vladal Etiopiji 1977–1991; z rdečim terorjem je dal pobiti več deset tisoč ljudi in bil v odsotnosti obsojen zaradi genocida.
osebe.opis_en: Ruled Ethiopia in 1977–1991 as head of the Derg junta; his Red Terror killed tens of thousands, and he was convicted of genocide in absentia.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Mengistu, Adis Abeba 1977: razglasi rdeči teror proti nasprotnikom režima
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Mengistu, Addis Ababa 1977: proclaims the Red Terror against opponents of the regime

osebe.opis_sl: Politični voditelj bosanskih Srbov med vojno v BiH, ki ga je mednarodno sodišče obsodilo zaradi genocida v Srebrenici, obleganja Sarajeva in drugih zločinov.
osebe.opis_en: Bosnian Serb political leader during the Bosnian war, convicted by an international tribunal of genocide at Srebrenica, the siege of Sarajevo and other crimes.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Karadžić, Haag 2016: mednarodno sodišče ga obsodi zaradi genocida v Srebrenici in drugih zločinov
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Karadžić, The Hague 2016: UN tribunal convicts him of genocide at Srebrenica and other crimes

osebe.opis_sl: Diktator Severne Koreje 1994–2011, ki je vzdrževal taborišča za politične zapornike; med lakoto v 90. letih je umrlo več sto tisoč ljudi.
osebe.opis_en: Dictator of North Korea 1994–2011 who maintained political prison camps; hundreds of thousands died in the famine of the 1990s.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Kim, Severna Koreja 2006: država izvede prvi jedrski poskus
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Kim, North Korea 2006: the country conducts its first nuclear test

osebe.opis_sl: Visoki poveljnik SS in vodja Glavnega urada za varnost rajha, ki je organiziral pobijanje Judov z enotami Einsatzgruppen in načrtovanje holokavsta.
osebe.opis_en: Senior SS commander and head of the Reich Security Main Office who organised the Einsatzgruppen killings of Jews and the planning of the Holocaust.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Heydrich, Berlin 1942: vodi konferenco v Wannseeju o izvedbi »dokončne rešitve judovskega vprašanja«
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Heydrich, Berlin 1942: chairs the Wannsee Conference on implementing the 'Final Solution'

osebe.opis_sl: Čilski general in diktator v letih 1973–1990, pod čigar režimom so bili tisoči ljudi ubiti ali so izginili, desettisoči pa zaprti in mučeni.
osebe.opis_en: Chilean general and dictator from 1973 to 1990 whose regime killed or disappeared thousands of people and imprisoned and tortured tens of thousands.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Pinochet, Santiago 1973: z vojaškim udarom strmoglavi vlado Salvadorja Allendeja
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Pinochet, Santiago 1973: overthrows Salvador Allende's government in a military coup

osebe.opis_sl: Sudanski vojaški vladar 1989–2019; Mednarodno kazensko sodišče ga obtožuje genocida in zločinov proti človečnosti v Darfurju, kjer je umrlo okoli 300.000 ljudi.
osebe.opis_en: Sudanese military ruler from 1989 to 2019, charged by the International Criminal Court with genocide and crimes against humanity in Darfur, where some 300,000 died.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Al Bašir, Darfur 2003: vladne sile in milice džandžavid začnejo množične poboje civilistov
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Al-Bashir, Darfur 2003: government forces and Janjaweed militias begin mass killings of civilians

osebe.opis_sl: Kot osmanski notranji minister in pozneje veliki vezir je bil glavni organizator armenskega genocida, v katerem je umrlo do 1,5 milijona Armencev.
osebe.opis_en: As Ottoman interior minister and later grand vizier, he was the chief organiser of the Armenian genocide, in which up to 1.5 million Armenians died.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Talat paša, Carigrad 1915: ukaže aretacije armenskih voditeljev, s katerimi se začne genocid
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Talaat Pasha, Constantinople 1915: orders the arrest of Armenian leaders, beginning the genocide

osebe.opis_sl: Vlaški knez, ki je z množičnim nabijanjem na kol ustrahoval nasprotnike in podanike ter povzročil smrt več tisoč ljudi.
osebe.opis_en: Prince of Wallachia who terrorised enemies and subjects through mass impalement, causing the deaths of thousands.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Vlad, Târgoviște 1462: osmanska vojska pred njegovo prestolnico naleti na tisoče ujetnikov, nabitih na kole
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Vlad, Târgoviște 1462: the invading Ottoman army finds thousands of impaled captives near his capital

osebe.opis_sl: Poveljnik vojske bosanskih Srbov, ki ga je mednarodno sodišče obsodilo zaradi genocida v Srebrenici, kjer je bilo ubitih okoli 8000 Bošnjakov, in obleganja Sarajeva.
osebe.opis_en: Bosnian Serb army commander convicted by an international tribunal of genocide at Srebrenica, where about 8,000 Bosniaks were killed, and of the siege of Sarajevo.
osebe.kljucni_trenutek: Mladić, Srebrenica 1995: njegove sile po zavzetju mesta pobijejo okoli 8000 bošnjaških moških in dečkov
osebe.kljucni_trenutek_en: Mladić, Srebrenica 1995: after taking the town his forces kill about 8,000 Bosniak men and boys

aliases_opis: R1 id-ji, ki v R2 niso na seznamih: skupine (alias_za = posamezniki v R2) in osebe izven top 25; id-ji so stalni
people_opis: za igro /game/: najprej zapisi R1 id-jev, ki jih v R2 ni (alias: true), nato vsa področja razen Zloglasnih, urejeno po mestu (vsi s 1. mesta, nato vsi z 2. …)

people.kratek_opis: Zgradila sta prvo motorno letalo, ki je opravilo nadzorovan let, in razvila krmiljenje okoli treh osi.
people.kratek_opis_en: Built the first powered aeroplane to make a controlled, sustained flight and devised three-axis flight control.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Brata Wright, Kitty Hawk 1903: prvi nadzorovani motorni let (12 s)
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Wright brothers, Kitty Hawk 1903: first controlled powered flight (12 s)

people.kratek_opis: Na dvoru dinastije Han je izboljšal izdelavo papirja iz lubja, konoplje, cunj in ribiških mrež.
people.kratek_opis_en: At the Han court he improved papermaking from tree bark, hemp, rags and old fishing nets.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Cai Lun, Luoyang 105: cesarju predstavi postopek izdelave papirja
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Cai Lun, Luoyang 105: presents his papermaking process to the emperor

people.kratek_opis: Liverpoolska skupina, ki je s pesmimi Lennona in McCartneyja ter studijskimi poskusi preoblikovala popularno glasbo.
people.kratek_opis_en: Liverpool band whose Lennon–McCartney songs and studio experiments transformed popular music.
people.kljucni_trenutek: The Beatles, London 1967: izid albuma Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: The Beatles, London 1967: release of Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band

people.kratek_opis: Grška arhitekta, ki sta v Periklovem času zgradila Partenon na atenski Akropoli, dorski tempelj boginje Atene.
people.kratek_opis_en: Greek architects who built the Parthenon, the Doric temple of Athena on the Athenian Acropolis, in the age of Pericles.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Iktin in Kalikrat, Atene 447 pr. n. št.: začne se gradnja Partenona
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Ictinus and Callicrates, Athens 447 BC: work on the Parthenon begins

people.kratek_opis: Atenski tragik, ki je uvedel tretjega igralca in napisal Kralja Ojdipa in Antigono; ohranjenih je sedem tragedij.
people.kratek_opis_en: Athenian tragedian who introduced the third actor and wrote Oedipus Rex and Antigone; seven of his tragedies survive.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Sofoklej, Atene 468 pr. n. št.: prva zmaga na Dionizijah, pred Ajshilom
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Sophocles, Athens 468 BC: first victory at the Dionysia, over Aeschylus

people.kratek_opis: V Vladarju je stvarno analiziral pridobivanje in ohranjanje oblasti ter odprl pot moderni politični znanosti.
people.kratek_opis_en: The Prince analysed how power is gained and kept, opening the way to modern political science.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Machiavelli, Sant'Andrea in Percussina 1513: v izgnanstvu napiše Vladarja
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Machiavelli, Sant'Andrea in Percussina 1513: writes The Prince in exile

people.kratek_opis: Analizirala je totalitarizem, politično delovanje in »banalnost zla« ter vplivala na sodobno politično teorijo.
people.kratek_opis_en: Her studies of totalitarianism, political action and the “banality of evil” reshaped political theory.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Hannah Arendt, Jeruzalem 1961: za The New Yorker poroča z Eichmannovega procesa
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Hannah Arendt, Jerusalem 1961: reports on the Eichmann trial for The New Yorker

people.kratek_opis: Kartažanski vojskovodja, ki je s prečkanjem Alp presenetil Rim in nato 15 let vojskoval v Italiji.
people.kratek_opis_en: Carthaginian general who surprised Rome by crossing the Alps and then campaigned in Italy for 15 years.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Hanibal, Kane 216 pr. n. št.: dvojna obkolitev uniči rimsko vojsko
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Hannibal, Cannae 216 BC: a double envelopment destroys the Roman army

people.kratek_opis: Pripisujejo mu »Umetnost vojne«, kitajsko razpravo o strategiji, ki vpliva na vojaško in poslovno misel.
people.kratek_opis_en: Credited with “The Art of War”, a Chinese treatise on strategy that still shapes military and business thinking.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Sun Zi, Wu ok. 512 pr. n. št.: po izročilu preda kralju Heluju »Umetnost vojne«
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Sun Tzu, Wu c. 512 BC: by tradition presents The Art of War to King Helü

people.kratek_opis: Rimski vojskovodja, ki je vojno prenesel v Afriko in Hanibala premagal s prilagojenimi kartažanskimi taktikami.
people.kratek_opis_en: Roman general who carried the war to Africa and defeated Hannibal by adapting Carthaginian tactics.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Scipion, Zama 202 pr. n. št.: zmaga nad Hanibalom konča drugo punsko vojno
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Scipio, Zama 202 BC: victory over Hannibal ends the Second Punic War

people.kratek_opis: Sovjetski maršal, ki je vodil obrambo Moskve, soustvaril protinapad pri Stalingradu in vodil ofenzivo na Berlin.
people.kratek_opis_en: Soviet marshal who led the defence of Moscow, co-planned the Stalingrad counteroffensive and led the Berlin offensive.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Žukov, Moskva 1941: protiofenziva potisne nemško vojsko od mesta
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Zhukov, Moscow 1941: counteroffensive drives German forces back from the city

people.kratek_opis: Arabski vojskovodja zgodnjega islama, ki je s hitrimi pohodi vodil osvajanje Iraka in bizantinske Sirije.
people.kratek_opis_en: Early Muslim Arab commander whose fast-moving campaigns led the conquest of Iraq and Byzantine Syria.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Halid, Jarmuk 636: zmaga nad bizantinsko vojsko odloči usodo Sirije
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Khalid, Yarmouk 636: victory over the Byzantine army decides the fate of Syria

people.kratek_opis: Francoska izumitelja kinematografa, kamere in projektorja v enem, ki sta začela javne filmske predstave.
people.kratek_opis_en: French inventors of the Cinématographe, a camera and projector in one, who launched public film screenings.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Brata Lumière, Pariz 1895: javna plačljiva projekcija filmov v Grand Caféju
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Lumière brothers, Paris 1895: public paid film screening at the Grand Café

people.kratek_opis: S teorijama relativnosti je na novo opredelil prostor, čas in gravitacijo ter pojasnil fotoelektrični pojav.
people.kratek_opis_en: His special and general relativity redefined space, time and gravity; he also explained the photoelectric effect.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Einstein, Bern 1905: posebna teorija relativnosti
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Einstein, Bern 1905: special theory of relativity

people.kratek_opis: Postavil je heliocentrični model, v katerem Zemlja in drugi planeti krožijo okoli Sonca.
people.kratek_opis_en: Proposed the heliocentric model in which Earth and the other planets orbit the Sun.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Kopernik, Nürnberg 1543: izide delo O kroženju nebesnih sfer
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Copernicus, Nuremberg 1543: De revolutionibus published

people.kategorija: Znanost – kemija in vede o Zemlji
people.kratek_opis: Sestavil je periodni sistem elementov in na podlagi njegovih vrzeli napovedal lastnosti še neodkritih elementov.
people.kratek_opis_en: Devised the periodic table of the elements and used its gaps to predict the properties of undiscovered elements.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Mendelejev, Sankt Peterburg 1869: predstavi periodni sistem elementov
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Mendeleev, Saint Petersburg 1869: presents his periodic table of the elements

people.kratek_opis: Razvoj vrst je pojasnil z naravnim izborom in s tem postavil temelje sodobne evolucijske biologije.
people.kratek_opis_en: Explained the evolution of species by natural selection, laying the foundations of modern evolutionary biology.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Darwin, London 1859: izide knjiga O nastanku vrst
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Darwin, London 1859: On the Origin of Species published

people.kratek_opis: V Elementih je geometrijo zgradil iz aksiomov in dokazov ter postavil vzor matematične strogosti.
people.kratek_opis_en: Built geometry from axioms and proofs in the Elements, setting the model of mathematical rigour.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Evklid, Aleksandrija ok. 300 pr. n. št.: nastanejo Elementi
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Euclid, Alexandria c. 300 BC: the Elements are written

people.kratek_opis: Izumil je fonograf, razvil praktično žarnico z žarilno nitko in sistem za distribucijo elektrike.
people.kratek_opis_en: Invented the phonograph and developed a practical incandescent light bulb and electric power distribution.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Edison, Menlo Park 1877: fonograf posname in predvaja glas
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Edison, Menlo Park 1877: the phonograph records and plays back a voice

people.kratek_opis: Izumil je svetovni splet, zasnoval HTML, HTTP in URL ter jih dal prosto na voljo vsem.
people.kratek_opis_en: Invented the World Wide Web, designing HTML, HTTP and URLs, and made them freely available to all.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Berners-Lee, CERN 1989: predlog sistema, ki postane svetovni splet
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Berners-Lee, CERN 1989: the proposal that became the World Wide Web

people.kratek_opis: Bolezni je razlagal z naravnimi vzroki namesto z nadnaravnimi in postavil temelje zdravniške etike.
people.kratek_opis_en: Explained disease by natural rather than supernatural causes and laid the foundations of medical ethics.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Hipokrat, Kos ok. 400 pr. n. št.: po izročilu nastane Hipokratova prisega
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Hippocrates, Kos c. 400 BC: the Hippocratic Oath, by tradition

people.kratek_opis: Vzgojil je visokorodne, proti boleznim odporne sorte pšenice, ki so v zeleni revoluciji povečale pridelek v Mehiki, Indiji in Pakistanu.
people.kratek_opis_en: Bred high-yield, disease-resistant wheat varieties that raised harvests in Mexico, India and Pakistan during the Green Revolution.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Borlaug, Oslo 1970: prejme Nobelovo nagrado za mir za prispevek k boju proti lakoti
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Borlaug, Oslo 1970: receives the Nobel Peace Prize for his contribution to fighting hunger

people.kratek_opis: Češki pedagog, ki je zagovarjal splošno izobraževanje za vse in napisal enega prvih slikovnih učbenikov za otroke, Orbis pictus.
people.kratek_opis_en: Czech educator who advocated universal education and wrote Orbis Pictus, one of the first picture textbooks for children.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Komenský, Nürnberg 1658: izide slikovni učbenik Orbis pictus
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Comenius, Nuremberg 1658: picture textbook Orbis Pictus published

people.kategorija_en: Law and the rule of law
people.kratek_opis: Babilonski kralj, ki je dal zapisati Hamurabijev zakonik, eno najstarejših in najobsežnejših ohranjenih zbirk zakonov.
people.kratek_opis_en: Babylonian king who issued the Code of Hammurabi, one of the oldest and most complete surviving collections of laws.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Hamurabi, ok. 1754 pr. n. št.: zakonik je vklesan v kamnito stelo
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Hammurabi, c. 1754 BC: his law code is inscribed on a stone stele

people.kratek_opis: Z nenasilnim uporom (satjagraho) je vodil indijsko gibanje za neodvisnost in navdihnil gibanja po svetu.
people.kratek_opis_en: Led India's independence movement through non-violent resistance (satyagraha), inspiring movements worldwide.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Gandhi, Dandi 1930: solni pohod sklene s simbolično kršitvijo britanskega solnega zakona
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Gandhi, Dandi 1930: ends the Salt March by making salt in defiance of British law

people.kratek_opis: V dialogih je razvil nauk o idejah ter postavil temelje zahodne metafizike, etike in politične misli.
people.kratek_opis_en: His dialogues developed the theory of Forms and laid foundations of Western metaphysics, ethics and politics.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Platon, Atene ok. 387 pr. n. št.: ustanovi Akademijo
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Plato, Athens c. 387 BC: founds the Academy

people.kratek_opis: Judovski učitelj iz Galileje, čigar nauk o ljubezni in Božjem kraljestvu je izhodišče krščanstva.
people.kratek_opis_en: Jewish teacher from Galilee whose message of love and the Kingdom of God is the foundation of Christianity.
people.obdobje: ok. 4 pr. n. št.–ok. 30/33 n. št.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Jezus, reka Jordan ok. 28: po evangelijih krst pri Janezu in začetek javnega delovanja
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Jesus, Jordan River c. AD 28: per the Gospels, baptized by John, begins his ministry

people.kratek_opis: Vodil je ameriško vojsko do neodvisnosti in kot prvi predsednik ZDA postavil zgled mirne predaje oblasti.
people.kratek_opis_en: Led American forces to independence and, as first US president, set the precedent of a peaceful transfer of power.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Washington, reka Delaware 1776: božično prečkanje in zmaga pri Trentonu
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Washington, Delaware River 1776: Christmas-night crossing and victory at Trenton

people.kratek_opis: Z družbo Standard Oil je obvladoval ameriško naftno industrijo, nato pa velik del premoženja namenil dobrodelnosti, zlasti medicini in izobraževanju.
people.kratek_opis_en: Dominated the US oil industry through Standard Oil, then gave much of his fortune to philanthropy, especially medicine and education.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Rockefeller, Cleveland 1870: ustanovi družbo Standard Oil
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Rockefeller, Cleveland 1870: founds Standard Oil

people.kljucni_trenutek: Farnsworth, San Francisco 1927: prvič elektronsko prenese sliko, ravno črto
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Farnsworth, San Francisco 1927: first electronic transmission of an image, a straight line

people.kratek_opis: Neodvisno od Jacka Kilbyja je izumil monolitno integrirano vezje na siliciju ter soustanovil podjetji Fairchild Semiconductor in Intel.
people.kratek_opis_en: Independently of Jack Kilby invented the monolithic silicon integrated circuit and co-founded Fairchild Semiconductor and Intel.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Noyce, Mountain View 1968: z Gordonom Moorom ustanovi podjetje Intel
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Noyce, Mountain View 1968: co-founds Intel with Gordon Moore

people.kratek_opis: Kot vojaški kirurg je opustil žganje strelnih ran z vrelim oljem in pri amputacijah uveljavil podvezovanje žil, kar je izboljšalo oskrbo ran.
people.kratek_opis_en: As a military surgeon he abandoned cauterizing gunshot wounds with boiling oil and promoted ligature of blood vessels in amputations, improving wound care.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Paré, Torino 1537: ko mu zmanjka vrelega olja, rane oskrbi z blažilnim mazilom in ugotovi, da se bolje celijo
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Paré, Turin 1537: running out of boiling oil, he dresses wounds with a soothing salve and finds they heal better

people.kratek_opis: Francoski farmacevt in agronom, ki je v Franciji uveljavil krompir kot živilo proti lakoti ter raziskoval prehrano in higieno živil.
people.kratek_opis_en: French pharmacist and agronomist who promoted the potato in France as a food against famine and studied nutrition and food hygiene.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Parmentier, Pariz ok. 1786: na polju Les Sablons goji krompir, da bi ga populariziral
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Parmentier, Paris c. 1786: grows potatoes on the Les Sablons field to popularise them

people.kratek_opis: Okulist, ki je ustvaril esperanto, umetni jezik za lažje mednarodno sporazumevanje.
people.kratek_opis_en: Ophthalmologist who created Esperanto, a constructed language for easier international communication.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Zamenhof, Varšava 1887: pod psevdonimom Doktoro Esperanto izda prvi učbenik jezika
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Zamenhof, Warsaw 1887: publishes the first textbook of the language as Doktoro Esperanto

people.kategorija_en: Law and the rule of law
people.kratek_opis: Španski teolog salamanške šole, ki je zagovarjal pravice ameriških staroselcev in velja za enega od utemeljiteljev mednarodnega prava.
people.kratek_opis_en: Spanish theologian of the School of Salamanca who defended the rights of the Indigenous peoples of the Americas; regarded as a founder of international law.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Vitoria, Salamanca 1539: v predavanju De Indis obravnava pravice staroselcev Amerike
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Vitoria, Salamanca 1539: his lecture De Indis addresses the rights of the Indigenous peoples of the Americas

people.kratek_opis: S Césarjem Chávezom je soustanovila sindikat kmetijskih delavcev, vodila pogajanja za njihove pogodbe in skovala geslo »Sí, se puede«.
people.kratek_opis_en: Co-founded the farmworkers' union with César Chávez, negotiated its labour contracts and coined the slogan 'Sí, se puede'.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Huerta, 1962: s Chávezom ustanovi Nacionalno združenje kmetijskih delavcev
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Huerta, 1962: co-founds the National Farm Workers Association with Chávez

people.kratek_opis: V delu Drugi spol je analizirala, kako družba oblikuje položaj žensk, in s tem vplivala na feministično misel.
people.kratek_opis_en: In The Second Sex she analysed how society shapes women's position, influencing feminist thought.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Beauvoir, Pariz 1949: izide delo Drugi spol
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Beauvoir, Paris 1949: The Second Sex published

people.kratek_opis: Bengalski mistik, ki je učil, da so različne religije poti do istega Boga; njegov učenec Vivekananda je ustanovil Ramakrišnov misijon.
people.kratek_opis_en: Bengali mystic who taught that different religions are paths to the same God; his disciple Vivekananda founded the Ramakrishna Mission.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Ramakrišna, Dakšinešvar 1855: začne služiti v novem templju boginje Kali pri Kalkuti
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Ramakrishna, Dakshineswar 1855: begins serving at the new Kali temple near Calcutta

people.kratek_opis: Kot prvi predsednik vlade Singapurja je vodil hiter gospodarski razvoj države v strogo nadzorovanem političnem sistemu.
people.kratek_opis_en: As Singapore's first Prime Minister he oversaw the country's rapid economic development under a tightly controlled political system.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Lee, Singapur 1965: po ločitvi od Malezije vodi Singapur v neodvisnost
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Lee, Singapore 1965: leads Singapore into independence after its separation from Malaysia

people.kratek_opis: Bančnik in industrialec, ki je financiral podjetja, kot sta Alcoa in Gulf Oil, ter bil ameriški finančni minister (1921–1932).
people.kratek_opis_en: Banker and industrialist who financed firms such as Alcoa and Gulf Oil and served as US Secretary of the Treasury (1921–1932).
people.kljucni_trenutek: Mellon, Washington 1937: podari zbirko umetnin in sredstva za Narodno galerijo umetnosti
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Mellon, Washington 1937: donates his art collection and funds for the National Gallery of Art

people.kratek_opis: Kot prefekt departmaja Seine pod Napoleonom III. je vodil obsežno prenovo Pariza s širokimi bulvarji, parki in kanalizacijo.
people.kratek_opis_en: As prefect of the Seine under Napoleon III directed the large-scale rebuilding of Paris with wide boulevards, parks and sewers.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Haussmann, Pariz 1853: imenovan je za prefekta departmaja Seine in začne prenovo mesta
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Haussmann, Paris 1853: appointed prefect of the Seine and begins rebuilding the city

people.kratek_opis: Danski pomorščak v ruski službi, ki je vodil kamčatski odpravi in raziskal severni Tihi ocean med Azijo in Severno Ameriko.
people.kratek_opis_en: Danish navigator in Russian service who led the Kamchatka expeditions and explored the North Pacific between Asia and North America.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Bering, 1728: prepluje ožino med Azijo in Ameriko, ki danes nosi njegovo ime
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Bering, 1728: sails through the strait between Asia and America that now bears his name

people.kratek_opis: V romanih, kot je Ljubljena, je upodabljala zgodovino in izkušnje temnopoltih Američanov; leta 1993 je prejela Nobelovo nagrado za književnost.
people.kratek_opis_en: In novels such as Beloved she portrayed the history and experience of African Americans; awarded the 1993 Nobel Prize in Literature.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Morrison, Stockholm 1993: kot prva Afroameričanka prejme Nobelovo nagrado za književnost
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Morrison, Stockholm 1993: becomes the first African American woman to receive the Nobel Prize in Literature

people.kratek_opis: Češki skladatelj, ki je prvine ljudske glasbe vpletal v klasične oblike; znan je po Slovanskih plesih, simfoniji Iz novega sveta in operi Rusalka.
people.kratek_opis_en: Czech composer who wove folk elements into classical forms, known for his Slavonic Dances, the New World Symphony and the opera Rusalka.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Dvořák, New York 1893: krstna izvedba simfonije Iz novega sveta
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Dvořák, New York 1893: premiere of the New World Symphony

people.kratek_opis: Bluesovski kitarist in pevec, čigar izrazno igranje solov z upogibanjem strun je vplivalo na generacije kitaristov.
people.kratek_opis_en: Blues guitarist and singer whose expressive string-bending solo style influenced generations of guitarists.
people.kljucni_trenutek: King, Chicago 1964: v gledališču Regal posname album v živo Live at the Regal
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: King, Chicago 1964: records the live album Live at the Regal at the Regal Theater

people.kratek_opis: Japonski slikar in grafik ukiyo-e, avtor serije barvnih lesorezov Šestintrideset pogledov na goro Fudži.
people.kratek_opis_en: Japanese ukiyo-e painter and printmaker, creator of the woodblock print series Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Hokusai, Edo ok. 1831: izide lesorez Veliki val ob Kanagavi
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Hokusai, Edo c. 1831: woodblock print The Great Wave off Kanagawa published

people.kratek_opis: Ameriška filmska igralka in pevka, osrednja hollywoodska zvezda 50. let, med drugim v filmu Nekateri so za vroče.
people.kratek_opis_en: American actress and singer, a leading Hollywood star of the 1950s, known for films such as Some Like It Hot.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Monroe, New York 1962: v dvorani Madison Square Garden zapoje Happy Birthday predsedniku Kennedyju
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Monroe, New York 1962: sings Happy Birthday to President Kennedy at Madison Square Garden

people.kratek_opis: Indijski igralec kriketa, ki je v 24-letni mednarodni karieri kot prvi dosegel sto mednarodnih centurij (vsaj 100 tekov v enem nastopu).
people.kratek_opis_en: Indian cricketer who, in a 24-year international career, became the first player to score one hundred international centuries.
people.kljucni_trenutek: Tendulkar, Mumbaj 2011: z Indijo osvoji svetovno prvenstvo v kriketu
people.kljucni_trenutek_en: Tendulkar, Mumbai 2011: wins the Cricket World Cup with India
